purpose: Paired research comparison of two entry rules; no runtime rule promotion or broker orders.
entry_model: Only next contiguous observed candle open after a completed confirmation, with adverse slippage. No execution on the signal candle.
stop_target_policy: Both variants retain the original same-timeframe breakout stop and target. No widening, rebasing, partial exits, additions or trailing in this isolated entry comparison.
exit_model: Identical fixed barriers; stop before target if both touched; adverse stop gap at candle open; target fill capped at target; after 48 observed entry-timeframe bars exit at next open. Intrabar exit time is bounded by its candle; use candle close for conservative funding.
gap_policy: Missing candles censor pending opportunities and held positions; never interpolate. Structural warmup restarts after gaps. A normal price gap with contiguous candles uses adverse stop execution.
stress_model: Double modeled slippage on the same admitted trades, entry/exit times and quantities; do not filter the sample again under stress.
statistics_unit: One initial breakout event shared by both variants. No-entry contributes zero only after its observation window resolves. Pending/censored paired outcomes are excluded and counted. Overlapping events and BTC/ETH are not independent portfolio observations.
risk_unit: One unit of modeled initial net stop risk per admitted trade; stress uses the same base-risk quantity. Returns are opportunity-level R, not account returns.
boundary_policy: Purge development opportunities whose maximum retest plus hold window could cross holdout_start. Do not train or tune on the subsequent holdout.
uncertainty: Descriptive paired mean difference plus deterministic UTC-day cluster bootstrap over both assets. Few days and serial dependence prevent evidence of a deployable edge.
daily_ma_context: Not evaluated without a separately authenticated native completed D1 series; SMA50/SMA200 runtime rules remain unchanged.
promotion_policy: NONE; user review and independent validation are required before changing any portfolio strategy.
limitations: Coinbase spot research prices are not Binance execution prices and are not futures.
Historical OHLC does not identify bid/ask, queue position, exact intrabar ordering or source delivery latency.
The modeled costs are the owner-approved paper assumptions, not a claim about Coinbase account fees or achievable live fills.
This compares isolated entries and fixed exits; it does not replay all current portfolio filters, allocation, partial exits or protective runtime behavior.
The data endpoint documents that historical intervals can be incomplete; strict continuity checks are mandatory.
No profitability conclusion may be drawn from synthetic unit tests or from a zero-trade result.
